description: React component for managing and editing EF source mappings within an asset details page, including CRUD operations, form handling, and data table display.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Fetches the list of EF source mappings for the current asset and selected input parameter, updating the component's state.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Prepares the form for creating a new EF source mapping and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Populates the form with an existing mapping's data for editing and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles form submission, performs validation, and calls API endpoints to create or update EF source mappings.
